typeHints.fiscal: Deadlines for each issuer's tax returns and its Verifactu date (indicative: check it with your accountant).
typeHints.collection: Due dates of issued invoices awaiting payment. Overdue ones in red.
typeHints.reminder: Payment reminders prepared by the daily run, waiting for a partner to approve them.
typeHints.deal: Each deal's next action. Drag it to move it to another day.
typeHints.task: Dated tasks and project deliveries. Drag an unfinished task to move it to another day.
typeHints.meeting: Meetings and calls logged as activity (future ones are the planned ones).
typeHints.appointment: Events created here or synced with Google Calendar. Only you can see them.
typeHints.milestone: Dated billing milestones. Those not invoiced yet can be dragged.
typeHints.billing: What the daily run will invoice for monthly fees (and the first yearly fee), by contract.
typeHints.renewal: The anniversary of each yearly line: it's invoiced again on that day.
typeHints.contract: Starts, cancellations and changes of terms of contract lines.
typeHints.quote: How long each sent quote is valid for. Expired ones without a reply in red.
typeHints.issued: Issued invoices, on their issue date (history).

movable.deal: Changes the deal's next action (you can also drag it in the month or week view).
movable.task: Changes the task's date (you can also drag it in the month or week view).
movable.milestone: Changes the milestone's planned date. If it's automatic, the daily run will prepare it on that day.

readOnly.collection: The due date comes from the issued invoice and can't be moved. Record the payment or prepare a reminder from the invoice.
readOnly.issued: An issued invoice doesn't change date.
readOnly.reminder: The daily run prepared it on the right day: approve or discard it in the Outbox.
readOnly.billing: It comes from the lines' billing day: to change it, edit the contract lines.
readOnly.renewal: It renews on the line's anniversary: to change it, edit the line in the contract.
readOnly.contract: Starts and cancellations are changed in the contract lines.
readOnly.milestoneBilled: This milestone is already prepared for invoicing: its date can no longer be moved.
readOnly.deal: The date is changed in the deal.
readOnly.task: This task is already done: its date can't be moved. If it needs picking up again, reopen it in its project.
readOnly.project: The delivery date is changed on the project page.
readOnly.quote: The validity is changed by editing the quote.
readOnly.fiscal: The deadlines come from the AEAT calendar: they can't be moved.
readOnly.meeting: The date is changed in the activity, from the client's page.
readOnly.permission: Only a partner can move dates.

move.autoMilestone: It's automatic and already due: the daily run will prepare it next time it runs.
move.hint: Drag next actions, unfinished tasks and uninvoiced milestones to move them to another day. Everything else is changed on its own page.

fiscal.disclaimer: Indicative calendar: check it with your accountant. If the last day falls on a Saturday or Sunday, the deadline moves to Monday; public holidays aren't taken into account and, with direct debit, the deadline ends a few days earlier.
fiscal.verifactuBody: From this date, the issuer must issue invoices with a Verifactu-compliant system. With the internal provider, GNERAI OS will block issuing.

m303.description: Quarterly VAT return: the VAT on your invoices minus the VAT on your expenses. If there's tax to pay, it's paid when you file it.

m111.description: Payment of the IRPF withheld from employees and professionals (including partners paid by the SL).

m115.description: Payment of the 19% withholding on the rent for the premises or office, unless the landlord is exempt.

m130.description: Self-employed under direct assessment: 20% of the year's cumulative net income, minus what has already been paid and withheld. Not filed if at least 70% of the previous year's income was subject to withholding.

m349.description: Informative return on sales and purchases of services with companies in other EU countries (including Meta or Google Ads billed from Ireland).

m202.description: Payment on account of the year's Corporate Income Tax. Under the tax-liability method (modalidad de cuota), nothing is paid if the last tax came out at zero, or in the first year of activity.

m200.description: Annual Corporate Income Tax return for the previous financial year (when the financial year matches the calendar year).

m390.description: Informative summary of the year's 303 returns.

m190.description: Informative summary of the year's 111 returns, with each recipient.

m180.description: Informative summary of the year's 115 returns.

m347.description: Clients and suppliers with whom transactions exceeded €3,005.06 (VAT included) in the year, except those already reported in other returns.

subscribe.title: Subscribe to the calendar
subscribe.description: A private link to see these dates in Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook. It updates itself every few hours, with the next 12 months.

scopeHint.mine: Yours and what belongs to everyone (the SL's deadlines, for example).
scopeHint.all: Everything in the organization, from all partners.

subscribe.revoked: Link revoked: it no longer works in any calendar.
subscribe.copyFailed: It couldn't be copied: select it and copy it manually.
subscribe.onlyOnce: Save it now: for security, it won't be shown again. If you lose it, create a new one (the old one will stop working).
subscribe.stepGoogle: Google Calendar (web): Other calendars → + → From URL, and paste the link.
subscribe.stepApple: Apple Calendar: File → New Calendar Subscription, and paste the link.
subscribe.stepOutlook: Outlook: Add calendar → Subscribe from web, and paste the link.
subscribe.active: You've had an active link since {date} ({scope}).
subscribe.neverUsed: No calendar has read it yet.
subscribe.localWarning: The app is running locally: Google Calendar can't read a localhost link until it's published (Apple Calendar, on this same computer, can).
subscribe.privacy: Anyone with the link can see your dates, including clients and amounts. Don't share it; if it leaks, revoke it.
